text:
Lina: Quick sync — we’ll announce the release tomorrow AM. Need: changelog snippet for the post, canonical docs links, the benchmark narrative (few bullets), webinar slot confirmation, and inbound lead routing (SFDC mapping). Can engineering confirm timings and the final changelog? :calendar:
Omar: Deploy window is green — 09:00 PT. Canary at 08:30. I can drop a changelog snippet in here in 10.
Maya: From product: we want the benchmark to highlight latency/cost improvements vs. previous gen. Two bullets max. Also want the webinar CTA to push signups to /events/release-demo.
Eli: Docs: I'll pin the docs links once changelog lands. Current doc draft: https://redwood.docs/release-4.1 (WIP). Prefer we use canonical query params for UTM.
Omar: Changelog snippet (draft):
```
- Improved serving latency: ~25% median token latency reduction on gen workloads
- New routing policy: auto-fallback to quantized variants under load
- Fixed KV cache eviction bug affecting long conversations
```
Sam: For inbound routing — pls confirm which leads go to Growth vs. Sales. Recommended: demo signups -> Growth; enterprise interest form -> SDRs. We need hidden UTM+form field for plan intent.
product-bot: QA alert: release will include schema changes to /v1/generate response. Update SDKs before wide rollout.
Omar: SDK change looks minor, product-bot. We can push a patch to npm at 06:00 PT and link it in the post.
Eli: Docs links after SDK patch: /docs/sdk-migration and /docs/release-4-1-changelog. Will add anchor to benchmark section.
Lina: Webinar: can we get 30 minutes? Prefer 10:00 PT same day as release. Who’s presenting?
Maya: I'll present the product narrative, Omar can do 10 mins on infra/benchmarks, Sam will close with GTM CTA.
ops-bot: Deployment scheduled: release-4.1 -> staging at 06:00 PT, canary -> 08:30 PT, prod -> 09:00 PT. Rollback window: 09:30 PT - 10:00 PT.
Lina: Perfect. I'll draft the blog post + tweet thread with the changelog snippet and docs links and share for review by 17:00 PT. @omar @eli @sam please review ASAP.
Omar: Ack. Will post PR with final changelog in ~8m.
Eli: Ack, will prep the final docs and canonical links.
Sam: Ack, I'll wire the demo form and UTM params and confirm the SDR routing.
Lina: Thanks all — if anything changes ping here. :rocket:
